# archestra_mcp_catalog_label_values (Data Source)

Distinct label values across MCP registry catalog items, optionally filtered by `key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Values for a specific catalog-item label key. Drives dynamic catalog
# selection in HCL — e.g. picking every `category = "git"` catalog item
# without hard-coding their IDs.
data "archestra_mcp_catalog_label_values" "categories" {
  key = "category"
}

output "catalog_categories" {
  value = data.archestra_mcp_catalog_label_values.categories.values
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `key` (String) Optional label key to scope results.

### Read-Only

- `values` (List of String) Distinct label values across catalog items (filtered by `key` when set).
